paragraphs.en: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
paragraphs.zh: 面向 AI 编程智能体的上下文窗口优化。 对工具输出进行沙箱处理（减少 98%），持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP + hooks 在 17 个平台间强制执行路由。

sents.en: Context window optimization for AI coding agents.
sents.zh: 面向 AI 编程智能体的上下文窗口优化。

sents.en: Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
sents.zh: 对工具输出进行沙箱处理（减少 98%），持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP + hooks 在 17 个平台间强制执行路由。

paragraphs.en: Every MCP tool call dumps raw data into your context window. A Playwright snapshot costs 56 KB. Twenty GitHub issues cost 59 KB. One access log — 45 KB. After 30 minutes, 40% of your context is gone. And when the agent compacts the conversation to free space, it forgets which files it was editing, what tasks are in progress, and what you last asked for. On top of that, the agent wastes output tokens on filler, pleasantries, and verbose explanations — burning context from both sides.
paragraphs.zh: 每一次 MCP 工具调用都会把原始数据倾倒进你的上下文窗口。 一次 Playwright 快照就要占用 56 KB。 二十个 GitHub issue 要花掉 59 KB。一份访问日志——45 KB。 30 分钟后，你的上下文就少了 40%。 而当智能体为了腾出空间压缩对话时，它会忘记自己正在编辑哪些文件、有哪些任务在进行中，以及你最后要求的是什么。 除此之外，智能体还会把输出 token 浪费在填充语、客套话和冗长的解释上——从两头消耗上下文。

paragraphs.en: Context Mode is an MCP server that solves all four sides of this problem:
paragraphs.zh: Context Mode 是一个 MCP 服务器，能解决这个问题的全部四个方面：

paragraphs.en: Context Saving — Sandbox tools keep raw data out of the context window. 315 KB becomes 5.4 KB. 98% reduction.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文节省 — 沙盒工具将原始数据排除在上下文窗口之外。315 KB 变为 5.4 KB，减少 98%。

paragraphs.en: Session Continuity — Every file edit, git operation, task, error, and user decision is tracked in SQLite. When the conversation compacts, context-mode doesn't dump this data back into context — it indexes events into FTS5 and retrieves only what's relevant via BM25 search. The model picks up exactly where you left off. If you don't --continue , previous session data is deleted immediately — a fresh session means a clean slate.
paragraphs.zh: 会话连续性 — 每一次文件编辑、git 操作、任务、错误以及用户决策都会被记录到 SQLite 中。 当对话被压缩时，context-mode 不会把这些数据重新倾倒进上下文 — 它会将事件索引到 FTS5 中，并通过 BM25 搜索仅检索相关内容。 模型能精确地从你上次中断的地方继续。 如果你不使用 --continue，之前的会话数据会立即被删除 — 一个新会话意味着全新开始。

paragraphs.en: Think in Code — The LLM should program the analysis, not compute it. Instead of reading 50 files into context to count functions, the agent writes a script that does the counting and console.log() s only the result. One script replaces ten tool calls and saves 100x context. This is a mandatory paradigm across all 17 supported clients, plus the OpenClaw gateway integration: stop treating the LLM as a data processor, treat it as a code generator.
paragraphs.zh: 用代码思考——大语言模型应该通过编程来完成分析，而不是亲自计算。 智能体不再把 50 个文件读入上下文来统计函数数量，而是编写一个脚本执行统计，并只用 console.log() 输出结果。 一个脚本取代十次工具调用，节省 100 倍的上下文。 这是在所有 17 个受支持的客户端以及 OpenClaw 网关集成中强制执行的模式：不要把大语言模型当作数据处理者，要把它当作代码生成器。

paragraphs.en: // Before: 47 × Read() = 700 KB. After: 1 × ctx_execute() = 3.6 KB. ctx_execute ( "javascript" , ` const files = fs.readdirSync('src').filter(f => f.endsWith('.ts')); files.forEach(f => console.log(f + ': ' + fs.readFileSync('src/'+f,'utf8').split('\\n').length + ' lines')); ` ) ; No prose-style enforcement — context-mode keeps raw data out of context but never dictates how the model writes its final answer. Brevity, completeness, formatting — your model's call (or yours via your own CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md ). Aggressive brevity prompts have been shown to degrade coding/reasoning benchmarks ( Moonshot AI on kimi-k2.5 ) — the routing block stays focused on where data goes , not on how the model talks .

paragraphs.en: cp node_modules/context-mode/configs/gemini-cli/GEMINI.md ./GEMINI.md Why the BeforeTool matcher? paragraphs.en: npm install -g context-mode # the plugin's MCP server runs the global binary copilot plugin install mksglu/context-mode:configs/copilot-cli # registers MCP + hooks + routing skill The bundle's .mcp.json pins CONTEXT_MODE_PLATFORM=copilot-cli , so context-mode self-identifies as Copilot — ctx_upgrade and platform detection resolve copilot-cli even when Claude Code is co-installed (whose ~/.claude/ would otherwise win). No context-mode upgrade / agent call needed. To try it from a local clone before it lands on the default branch, point Copilot at the bundle directory: copilot --plugin-dir /path/to/context-mode/configs/copilot-cli .

paragraphs.en: npm install -g context-mode Register the MCP server with Copilot CLI's built-in command (writes ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json for you):
paragraphs.zh: npm install -g context-mode 使用 Copilot CLI 的内置命令注册 MCP 服务器（会自动为你写入 ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json）：

paragraphs.en: copilot mcp add context-mode -- context-mode Configure hooks in ~/.copilot/hooks/context-mode.json (or $COPILOT_HOME/hooks/context-mode.json ). The config uses flat { "type": "command", "command": "..." } entries; context-mode also writes a top-level "version": 1 , but that field is optional — the Copilot CLI accepts hook configs that omit it (it is pinned only for self-documentation). Copilot CLI fires six events context-mode uses:
paragraphs.zh: 执行 copilot mcp add context-mode -- context-mode，然后在 ~/.copilot/hooks/context-mode.json（或 $COPILOT_HOME/hooks/context-mode.json）中配置钩子。 该配置使用扁平的 { "type": "command", "command": "..." } 条目；context-mode 还会写入顶层的 "version": 1，但该字段是可选的——Copilot CLI 接受省略该字段的钩子配置（固定此字段仅用于自文档化）。 Copilot CLI 会触发 context-mode 所使用的六个事件：

sents.en: copilot mcp add context-mode -- context-mode Configure hooks in ~/.copilot/hooks/context-mode.json (or $COPILOT_HOME/hooks/context-mode.json ).
sents.zh: 执行 copilot mcp add context-mode -- context-mode，然后在 ~/.copilot/hooks/context-mode.json（或 $COPILOT_HOME/hooks/context-mode.json）中配置钩子。

sents.en: The config uses flat { "type": "command", "command": "..." } entries; context-mode also writes a top-level "version": 1 , but that field is optional — the Copilot CLI accepts hook configs that omit it (it is pinned only for self-documentation).
sents.zh: 该配置使用扁平的 { "type": "command", "command": "..." } 条目；context-mode 还会写入顶层的 "version": 1，但该字段是可选的——Copilot CLI 接受省略该字段的钩子配置（固定此字段仅用于自文档化）。

sents.en: Copilot CLI fires six events context-mode uses:
sents.zh: Copilot CLI 会触发 context-mode 所使用的六个事件：

paragraphs.en: { "version" : 1 , "hooks" : { "preToolUse" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli pretooluse " }], "postToolUse" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli posttooluse " }], "preCompact" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli precompact " }], "sessionStart" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli sessionstart " }], "userPromptSubmitted" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli userpromptsubmit " }], "agentStop" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli stop " }] } } Or let context-mode write this hooks file for you: context-mode upgrade (run from a Copilot CLI context, or with CONTEXT_MODE_PLATFORM=copilot-cli ). upgrade writes the hooks file only — register the MCP server with copilot mcp add in step 2.
paragraphs.zh: { "version" : 1 , "hooks" : { "preToolUse" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli pretooluse " }], "postToolUse" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli posttooluse " }], "preCompact" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli precompact " }], "sessionStart" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli sessionstart " }], "userPromptSubmitted" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli userpromptsubmit " }], "agentStop" : [{ "type" : " command " , "command" : " context-mode hook copilot-cli stop " }] } } 或者，让 context-mode 为你写入这个 hooks 文件： context-mode upgrade （在 Copilot CLI 上下文中运行，或设置 CONTEXT_MODE_PLATFORM=copilot-cli ）。 upgrade 只写入 hooks 文件——请按照第 2 步使用 copilot mcp add 注册 MCP 服务器。

paragraphs.en: Version note: the hook commands run the global context-mode ( context-mode hook copilot-cli … ), so they need a context-mode version with Copilot CLI support. On an older global the hooks are inert (no routing/capture) until you upgrade — but they do not block your tools (context-mode fails open). Upgrade with npm install -g context-mode@latest .

paragraphs.en: Prerequisites: Node.js >= 22.5 (or Bun), OpenCode installed.

paragraphs.en: Add to opencode.json in your project root (or ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json for global):

paragraphs.en: { "$schema" : " https://opencode.ai/config.json " , "plugin" : [ " context-mode " ] } The plugin entry registers all 11 ctx_* tools natively and enables hooks — OpenCode calls context-mode's TypeScript plugin in-process, so there is no redundant stdio MCP child per session.
paragraphs.zh: { "$schema" : " https://opencode.ai/config.json " , "plugin" : [ " context-mode " ] } 该插件条目会原生注册全部 11 个 ctx_* 工具并启用钩子（hooks）——OpenCode 以进程内方式调用 context-mode 的 TypeScript 插件，因此每个会话不再需要冗余的 stdio MCP 子进程。

paragraphs.en: Upgrade note: If an existing config has BOTH plugin: ["context-mode"] AND mcp.context-mode , OpenCode will register zero ctx_* tools — the plugin path correctly suppresses MCP duplicates, but the legacy MCP entry confuses the loader. Run context-mode upgrade to remove the legacy mcp.context-mode entry; your other MCP servers are preserved. v1.0.140+ emits a stderr diagnostic with the same guidance when this happens.
paragraphs.zh: 升级说明：如果现有配置同时包含 plugin: ["context-mode"] 和 mcp.context-mode，OpenCode 将不会注册任何 ctx_* 工具——插件路径会正确抑制 MCP 重复项，但遗留的 MCP 条目会干扰加载器。 运行 context-mode upgrade 以移除遗留的 mcp.context-mode 条目；你的其他 MCP 服务器会被保留。v1.0.140 及以上版本在发生这种情况时会通过 stderr 输出包含相同指导的诊断信息。

paragraphs.en: Routing: Hooks enforce routing programmatically via tool.execute.before and tool.execute.after . The optional AGENTS.md file provides routing instructions for model awareness. The experimental.session.compacting hook builds resume snapshots when the conversation compacts. The experimental.chat.system.transform hook injects the routing block and prior-session snapshots at session start, enabling session continuity across restarts. The chat.message hook captures user prompts and decisions (UserPromptSubmit equivalent).
paragraphs.zh: 路由：Hooks 通过 tool.execute.before 和 tool.execute.after 以编程方式强制执行路由。 可选的 AGENTS.md 文件提供路由指令，供模型知晓。 experimental.session.compacting 钩子在对话压缩时构建恢复快照。 experimental.chat.system.transform 钩子在会话开始时注入路由块和先前会话的快照，从而实现跨重启的会话连续性。 chat.message 钩子捕获用户提示和决策（相当于 UserPromptSubmit）。

User-prompt capture uses chat.message instead of the missing UserPromptSubmit hook. AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/CONTEXT.md rules are captured automatically on first hook fire per project.

paragraphs.en: context-mode runs as a native OpenClaw gateway plugin, targeting Pi Agent sessions (Read/Write/Edit/Bash tools). Unlike other platforms, there's no separate MCP server — the plugin registers directly into the gateway runtime via OpenClaw's plugin API .

paragraphs.en: [ features ] plugin_hooks = true hooks = true Feature flag note: Current Codex builds expose hooks under [features].hooks (or codex --enable hooks ). paragraphs.en: Note: Kimi Code uses the same JSON stdin/stdout wire protocol as Codex, but accepts additionalContext , updatedInput , and permissionDecision: "ask" in PreToolUse responses (Codex rejects these). The kimi hook normalizes ContentPart[] prompt arrays to strings for downstream extractors.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：Kimi Code 使用与 Codex 相同的 JSON stdin/stdout 传输协议，但在 PreToolUse 响应中接受 additionalContext、updatedInput 以及 permissionDecision: "ask"（Codex 会拒绝这些内容）。 kimi 钩子会将 ContentPart[] 类型的提示词数组规范化为字符串，以便下游提取器使用。

paragraphs.en: Routing: Plugin path — programmatic enforcement via four pi.on(...) handlers ( tool_call returns { block: true, reason } for curl / wget /inline-fetch per upstream hooks/types.ts:566 , tool_result captures session events, session_start initializes the per-session DB row, session_before_compact persists a resume snapshot). ~98% compliance, parity with Claude Code hooks. MCP-only path — rule-based via SYSTEM.md , ~60% compliance. Auto-detected via PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR env var or presence of ~/.omp/ . Storage roots at ~/.omp/context-mode/ so OMP and Pi installs never share session DBs, content indices, or stats files.

paragraphs.en: Linux + Node.js >= 22.5: Context Mode automatically uses the built-in node:sqlite module instead of better-sqlite3 . This eliminates the native addon entirely, avoiding sporadic SIGSEGV crashes caused by V8's madvise(MADV_DONTNEED) corrupting the addon's .got.plt section on Linux. No configuration needed — detection is automatic. Linux + Node < 22.5 is unsupported ( #564 ) — npm install will fail with remediation instructions.
paragraphs.zh: Linux + Node.js >= 22.5：上下文模式（Context Mode）会自动使用内置的 node:sqlite 模块，而不是 better-sqlite3。 这完全消除了原生插件，避免了在 Linux 上由 V8 的 madvise(MADV_DONTNEED) 损坏插件的 .got.plt 区段而导致的偶发 SIGSEGV 崩溃。 无需任何配置——检测是自动进行的。 不支持 Linux + Node < 22.5（ #564 ）——npm install 将会失败，并给出修复指引。

paragraphs.en: Authenticated CLIs work through credential passthrough — gh , aws , gcloud , kubectl , docker inherit environment variables and config paths without exposing them to the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 经过身份验证的 CLI 通过凭据透传（credential passthrough）工作 — gh、aws、gcloud、kubectl、docker 会继承环境变量和配置路径，而不会将其暴露给对话。

paragraphs.en: When output exceeds 5 KB and an intent is provided, Context Mode switches to intent-driven filtering: it indexes the full output into the knowledge base, searches for sections matching your intent, and returns only the relevant matches with a vocabulary of searchable terms for follow-up queries.
paragraphs.zh: 当输出超过 5 KB 且提供了意图时，上下文模式（Context Mode）会切换为基于意图的过滤：它将完整输出索引到知识库中，搜索与你的意图匹配的部分，并仅返回相关匹配结果以及一份可用于后续查询的可搜索术语表。

paragraphs.en: The ctx_index tool chunks markdown content by headings while keeping code blocks intact, then stores them in a SQLite FTS5 (Full-Text Search 5) virtual table. The SQLite backend is selected automatically at runtime: bun:sqlite on Bun, node:sqlite on Node.js >= 22.5, and better-sqlite3 everywhere else. Search uses BM25 ranking — a probabilistic relevance algorithm that scores documents based on term frequency, inverse document frequency, and document length normalization. Porter stemming is applied at index time so "running", "runs", and "ran" match the same stem. Titles and headings are weighted 5x in BM25 scoring for precise navigational queries.
paragraphs.zh: ctx_index 工具按标题对 markdown 内容进行分块，同时保持代码块完整，然后将它们存储在 SQLite FTS5（全文搜索 5）虚拟表中。 SQLite 后端在运行时自动选择：在 Bun 上使用 bun:sqlite，在 Node.js >= 22.5 上使用 node:sqlite，在其他环境下使用 better-sqlite3。 搜索使用 BM25 排序——一种概率相关性算法，基于词频、逆文档频率和文档长度归一化为文档打分。 Porter 词干提取在索引时应用，因此 "running"、"runs" 和 "ran" 会匹配到相同的词干。 标题和小节标题在 BM25 评分中被赋予 5 倍权重，以支持精确的导航式查询。

paragraphs.en: When you call ctx_search , it returns relevant content snippets focused around matching query terms — not full documents, not approximations, the actual indexed content with smart extraction around what you're looking for. ctx_fetch_and_index extends this to URLs: fetch, convert HTML to markdown, chunk, index. The raw page never enters context. Use the contentType parameter to filter results by type (e.g. code or prose ).
paragraphs.zh: 当你调用 ctx_search 时，它返回围绕匹配查询词的相关内容片段——不是完整文档，不是近似内容，而是实际已索引的内容，并在你所查找的内容周围进行智能提取。ctx_fetch_and_index 将此能力扩展到 URL：抓取、将 HTML 转换为 markdown、分块、建立索引。 原始页面永远不会进入上下文。 使用 contentType 参数按类型过滤结果（例如 code 或 prose）。

paragraphs.en: Search runs two parallel strategies and merges them with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) :
paragraphs.zh: 搜索运行两种并行策略，并使用倒数排名融合（RRF）将它们合并：

paragraphs.en: RRF merges both ranked lists into a single result set, so a document that ranks well in both strategies surfaces higher than one that ranks well in only one. This replaces the old cascading fallback approach where trigram results were only used if porter returned nothing.
paragraphs.zh: RRF 将两个排序列表合并为一个结果集，因此在两种策略中都排名靠前的文档会排在仅在一种策略中排名靠前的文档之上。 这取代了旧的级联回退方案，即只有当 porter 没有返回任何结果时才使用 trigram 结果。

paragraphs.en: Multi-term queries get an additional reranking pass. Results where query terms appear close together are boosted — "session continuity" ranks passages with adjacent terms higher than pages where "session" and "continuity" appear paragraphs apart.
paragraphs.zh: 多词查询会获得一次额外的重排序处理。 查询词彼此接近出现的结果会被提升——「会话连续性」（session continuity）会对「session」和「continuity」相邻出现的段落给予比这两个词相隔数段出现的页面更高的排名。

paragraphs.zh: 搜索结果使用智能提取而非截断。 Context Mode 不再返回前 N 个字符（这可能会漏掉重要部分），而是查找你的查询词在内容中出现的位置，并返回这些匹配位置周围的窗口内容。

paragraphs.zh: 索引内容持久保存在每个项目对应的 SQLite 数据库中，路径为 ~/.context-mode/content/ 。 当 ctx_fetch_and_index 被调用以获取一个已在其 TTL 窗口内完成索引的 URL 时，抓取操作将被完全跳过，模型会直接搜索现有索引。

paragraphs.zh: ctx_stats 分别报告缓存性能：命中次数、避免的数据量、节省的网络请求数，以及包含缓存在内的总上下文节省量。

paragraphs.en: When the context window fills up, the agent compacts the conversation — dropping older messages to make room. Without session tracking, the model forgets which files it was editing, what tasks are in progress, what errors were resolved, and what you last asked for.
paragraphs.zh: 当上下文窗口被填满时，智能体会压缩对话——丢弃较旧的消息以腾出空间。 若没有会话跟踪，模型会忘记它正在编辑哪些文件、哪些任务正在进行、哪些错误已被解决，以及你最后一次请求的是什么。

paragraphs.en: Context Mode captures every meaningful event during your session and persists them in a per-project SQLite database. When the conversation compacts (or you resume with --continue , --resume , or /resume ), your working state is rebuilt automatically — the model continues from your last prompt without asking you to repeat anything.
paragraphs.zh: Context Mode 会捕获会话期间每个有意义的事件，并将其持久化到按项目划分的 SQLite 数据库中。 当对话被压缩时（或当你使用 --continue、--resume 或 /resume 恢复会话时），你的工作状态会自动重建——模型会从你上一次的提示继续，无需你重复任何内容。

paragraphs.en: Resuming a non-latest session via /resume <picker> works the same way: the SessionStart hook detects the empty live-event table for the freshly issued session id and falls back to the most recent unconsumed snapshot for the project ( session_resume table). The picker selects the conversation; context-mode rehydrates the prior working state.
paragraphs.zh: 通过 /resume <picker> 恢复非最新会话的工作方式相同：SessionStart 钩子检测到新发出的会话 id 对应的空实时事件表，并回退到该项目最近一次未被消费的快照（session_resume 表）。 选择器用于选定对话；上下文模式（context-mode）负责恢复先前的工作状态。

paragraphs.en: Note: Full session continuity (capture + snapshot + restore) works on Claude Code , Gemini CLI , VS Code Copilot , JetBrains Copilot , OpenCode , and KiloCode . GitHub Copilot CLI uses its own camelCase hook config keys ( preToolUse , postToolUse , preCompact , sessionStart , userPromptSubmitted , agentStop ) and top-level hook responses; it captures prompt, tool, compaction, session-start, and stop events when the plugin hooks are installed. OpenCode and KiloCode use experimental.chat.system.transform as a SessionStart surrogate to inject the routing block and restore prior sessions, plus chat.message for user-prompt capture; full SessionStart hook support is not yet available ( #14808 , #5409 ), but prior-session continuity and user-decision capture work fully. Cursor captures tool events via preToolUse / postToolUse , but sessionStart is currently rejected by Cursor's validator ( forum report ), so session restore after compaction is not available yet. OpenClaw uses native gateway plugin hooks ( api.on() ) for full session continuity. Pi Coding Agent provides high session continuity via extension hooks ( tool_call , tool_result , session_start , session_before_compact ). Codex CLI provides partial hook-based session tracking through PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreCompact, SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, and Stop; MCP tools work. Antigravity IDE and Zed have no hook support in the current release, so session tracking is not available there. Antigravity CLI ( agy ) is separate from the IDE and supports bounded PreToolUse , capture-only PostToolUse , and best-effort Stop through its plugin hooks. Kiro captures tool events via native preToolUse / postToolUse hooks, but its SessionStart equivalent ( agentSpawn ) is not yet wired, so session restore after compaction is unavailable. OMP (Oh My Pi) ships full plugin-based hook support — omp plugin install context-mode registers tool_call , tool_result , session_start , and session_before_compact handlers and storage roots cleanly under ~/.omp/context-mode/ so OMP and Pi installs never share state.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：完整的会话连续性（捕获 + 快照 + 恢复）在 Claude Code、Gemini CLI、VS Code Copilot、JetBrains Copilot、OpenCode 和 KiloCode 上均可使用。 GitHub Copilot CLI 使用其自带的 camelCase 钩子配置键（preToolUse、postToolUse、preCompact、sessionStart、userPromptSubmitted、agentStop）和顶层钩子响应；当安装了插件钩子后，它会捕获提示词、工具、压缩、会话启动和停止事件。 OpenCode 和 KiloCode 使用 experimental.chat.system.transform 作为 SessionStart 的替代来注入路由块并恢复先前会话，另外使用 chat.message 来捕获用户提示词；完整的 SessionStart 钩子支持尚不可用（#14808、#5409），但先前会话的连续性和用户决策捕获功能可完全正常工作。 Cursor 通过 preToolUse/postToolUse 捕获工具事件，但 sessionStart 目前会被 Cursor 的校验器拒绝（论坛报告），因此压缩后的会话恢复功能尚不可用。 OpenClaw 使用原生网关插件钩子（api.on()）实现完整的会话连续性。 Pi Coding Agent 通过扩展钩子（tool_call、tool_result、session_start、session_before_compact）提供较高的会话连续性。 Codex CLI 通过 PreToolUse、PostToolUse、PreCompact、SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit 和 Stop 提供基于钩子的部分会话跟踪；MCP 工具可用。 Antigravity IDE 和 Zed 在当前版本中没有钩子支持，因此在这些环境中无法进行会话跟踪。 Antigravity CLI（agy）独立于 IDE，通过其插件钩子支持有边界的 PreToolUse、仅捕获的 PostToolUse，以及尽力而为的 Stop。 Kiro 通过原生 preToolUse/postToolUse 钩子捕获工具事件，但其 SessionStart 的等价物（agentSpawn）尚未接入，因此压缩后的会话恢复功能不可用。 OMP（Oh My Pi）提供完整的基于插件的钩子支持——omp plugin install context-mode 会注册 tool_call、tool_result、session_start 和 session_before_compact 处理器，并将存储根目录整洁地置于 ~/.omp/context-mode/ 之下，因此 OMP 和 Pi 的安装不会共享状态。

paragraphs.en: Every tool call passes through hooks that extract structured events:
paragraphs.zh: 每一次工具调用都会经过提取结构化事件的钩子（hooks）：

paragraphs.en: PreCompact fires → Read all session events from SQLite → Build priority-tiered XML snapshot (≤2 KB) → Store snapshot in session_resume table SessionStart fires (source: "compact") → Retrieve stored snapshot → Write structured events file → auto-indexed into FTS5 → Build Session Guide with 15 categories → Inject <session_knowledge> directive into context → Model continues from last user prompt with full working state The snapshot is built in priority tiers — if the 2 KB budget is tight, lower-priority events (intent, MCP tool counts) are dropped first while critical state (active files, tasks, rules, decisions) is always preserved.
paragraphs.zh: PreCompact 触发 → 从 SQLite 读取所有会话事件 → 构建按优先级分层的 XML 快照（≤2 KB）→ 将快照存入 session_resume 表 SessionStart 触发（source: "compact"）→ 检索存储的快照 → 写入结构化事件文件 → 自动索引到 FTS5 → 构建包含 15 个类别的会话指南（Session Guide）→ 将 <session_knowledge> 指令注入上下文 → 模型从最后一个用户提示处带着完整的工作状态继续执行。快照按优先级分层构建——如果 2 KB 预算紧张，会先丢弃低优先级事件（意图、MCP 工具计数），而关键状态（活动文件、任务、规则、决策）始终会被保留。

paragraphs.en: OpenCode uses a TypeScript plugin paradigm — hooks run as in-process functions via tool.execute.before , tool.execute.after , experimental.session.compacting , experimental.chat.system.transform , and chat.message , providing full routing enforcement, session continuity, and user-prompt capture. The experimental.chat.system.transform hook acts as a SessionStart surrogate to inject the routing block and restore prior sessions. The chat.message hook captures user prompts and decisions (UserPromptSubmit equivalent).
paragraphs.zh: OpenCode 采用 TypeScript 插件范式——钩子以进程内函数的形式运行，通过 tool.execute.before、tool.execute.after、experimental.session.compacting、experimental.chat.system.transform 和 chat.message，提供完整的路由强制、会话连续性和用户提示词捕获。 experimental.chat.system.transform 钩子充当 SessionStart 的替代者，用于注入路由块并恢复先前的会话。 chat.message 钩子捕获用户提示词和决策（相当于 UserPromptSubmit）。

paragraphs.en: Codex CLI hooks require [features].hooks = true . MCP tools work, and hook scripts activate through $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json or ~/.codex/hooks.json . PreToolUse supports permissionDecision: "deny" only; input modification still needs upstream updatedInput support ( openai/codex#18491 ). additionalContext is not supported in PreToolUse (context injection works via PostToolUse and SessionStart instead; the codex formatter handles this automatically). PreCompact stores resume snapshots before compaction on Codex builds that emit the event, SessionStart restores them, and UserPromptSubmit/Stop capture prompt and turn-end continuity events. See the Codex install section for setup. Antigravity and Zed do not support hooks. They rely solely on manually-copied routing instruction files ( AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md ) for enforcement (~60% compliance). See each platform's install section for copy instructions. Antigravity and Zed are auto-detected via MCP protocol handshake — no manual platform configuration needed.

paragraphs.en: ctx stats → context savings, call counts, session report ctx doctor → diagnose runtimes, hooks, FTS5, versions ctx index → index a local file or directory for later search ctx search → search previously indexed content ctx upgrade → update from GitHub, rebuild, reconfigure hooks ctx purge → permanently delete all indexed content from the knowledge base ctx insight → opens the hosted Insight dashboard in your browser From your terminal — run directly without an AI session:

ctx stats → 显示上下文节省情况、调用次数、会话报告

ctx index → 为本地文件或目录建立索引，以便后续搜索
ctx search → 搜索之前已建立索引的内容

paragraphs.en: Start a multi-step task: "Create a REST API with Express — add routes, tests, and error handling." After 20+ tool calls, type: ctx stats to see the session event count. When context compacts, the model continues from your last prompt with tasks, files, and decisions intact — no re-prompting needed. Privacy & Architecture Context Mode is not a CLI output filter or a cloud analytics dashboard. It operates at the MCP protocol layer — raw data stays in a sandboxed subprocess and never enters your context window. Web pages, API responses, file analysis, Playwright snapshots, log files — everything is processed in complete isolation.

paragraphs.en: Commands chained with && , ; , or | are split — each part is checked separately. echo hello && sudo rm -rf /tmp is blocked because the sudo part matches the deny rule.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 && 、 ; 或 | 连接的命令会被拆分——每个部分分别检查。echo hello && sudo rm -rf /tmp 会被拦截，因为 sudo 部分匹配了拒绝规则。

paragraphs.en: ctx_execute_file is confined to the project root. A path that resolves outside the workspace — an absolute path like /home/user/secrets , a ../../ traversal, or a project-local symlink whose target escapes the project — is refused with a File access blocked error. This closes the #852 escape vector where an agent, denied an out-of-project read by the host sandbox, retried through the MCP sandbox (the host's MCP approval prompt cannot inspect the tool's input params, so the escape was invisible to the approver).

paragraphs.en: Reviewing the prompt: the ctx_execute / ctx_execute_file approval titles now read as code execution ("Run code in a sandbox…", "Run code over a file…") so an unfamiliar reviewer can recognise the action class even though the MCP prompt renders only the tool title and raw arguments. ctx_execute and ctx_batch_execute run arbitrary code and still inherit the process's filesystem access, so the boundary guard is a defense-in-depth layer for the file-read tool, not a full OS sandbox — treat approving any execution tool as approving arbitrary code, and keep host-level sandboxing enabled.
paragraphs.zh: 审查提示词：ctx_execute / ctx_execute_file 的审批标题现在以代码执行的形式呈现（“在沙箱中运行代码…”、“对文件运行代码…”），因此即使 MCP 提示词仅渲染工具标题和原始参数，不熟悉的审查者也能识别出该操作的类别。ctx_execute 和 ctx_batch_execute 会运行任意代码，并且仍然继承进程的文件系统访问权限，因此边界防护（boundary guard）是文件读取工具的纵深防御层，而非完整的操作系统沙箱——应将批准任何执行工具视为批准任意代码，并保持主机级沙箱处于启用状态。

paragraphs.en: tool_input for any mcp__* tool call is also redacted before persistence — the regex matcher in hooks/posttooluse.mjs masks authorization , auth_token , access_token , refresh_token , bearer , token , secret , password , passwd , pwd , api_key / apikey / x_api_key , cookie / set-cookie , signature , private_key , and client_secret (case-insensitive, hyphen/underscore-insensitive) to [REDACTED] so credentials in MCP arguments don't end up in the session DB.
paragraphs.zh: 任何 mcp__* 工具调用的 tool_input 在持久化之前也会被脱敏 —— hooks/posttooluse.mjs 中的正则匹配器会将 authorization 、 auth_token 、 access_token 、 refresh_token 、 bearer 、 token 、 secret 、 password 、 passwd 、 pwd 、 api_key / apikey / x_api_key 、 cookie / set-cookie 、 signature 、 private_key 和 client_secret （不区分大小写，不区分连字符/下划线）掩码为 [REDACTED]，从而确保 MCP 参数中的凭据不会进入会话数据库。
